integrity: Proof reconstructs paired Lagrange formula, an alternating third-difference estimate and uniform Gamma asymptotics. checker.py is supplemental finite verification, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Sharp moving-edge and logarithmic boundary-layer asymptotics only. The global interval norm receives an explicit lower bound, not a matching upper bound; no global maximizer location or uniqueness is claimed.
title: Exponential edge-layer amplification in Krawtchouk sign interpolation
